Form group printing not default main

Settings.QueryText: SELECT Documents.Ref AS Ref, BEGINOFPERIOD(Documents.Date, DAY) AS Date, BEGINOFPERIOD(Documents.ChangeDate, DAY) AS ChangeDate, Documents.Number AS Number, Documents.Hotel AS Hotel, Documents.Company AS Company, Documents.AccountingCustomer AS AccountingCustomer, Documents.AccountingContract AS AccountingContract, Documents.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, Documents.CorrectionSum AS Sum, CASE WHEN Documents.Posted THEN Documents.CorrectionSum - ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) ELSE 0 END AS Payment, ISNULL(InvoiceAccountsBalance.SumBalance, 0) AS Balance, Documents.IsChecked AS IsChecked, Documents.DoNotExportToTheAccountingSystem AS DoNotExportToTheAccountingSystem, Documents.DoNotExportToTheExternalSystem AS DoNotExportToTheExternalSystem, Documents.AccountingCurrency AS AccountingCurrency, Documents.Remarks AS Remarks, Documents.RemarksForPrinting AS RemarksForPrinting, Documents.Author AS Author, Documents.Posted AS Posted, Documents.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, Documents.CheckDate AS CheckDate FROM Document.DebitNote AS Documents LEFT JOIN AccumulationRegister.InvoiceAccounts.Balance(, ) AS InvoiceAccountsBalance ON Documents.Ref = InvoiceAccountsBalance.Invoice WHERE Documents.Hotel = &qHotel AND CASE WHEN &qGuestGroup = VALUE(Catalog.GuestGroups.EmptyRef) THEN TRUE WHEN &qGuestGroup <> VALUE(Catalog.GuestGroups.EmptyRef) AND Documents.GuestGroup = &qGuestGroup THEN TRUE WHEN &qGuestGroup <> VALUE(Catalog.GuestGroups.EmptyRef) AND Documents.Ref IN (SELECT DISTINCT DocServices.Ref FROM Document.DebitNote.Services AS DocServices WHERE DocServices.GuestGroup = &qGuestGroup) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
